about.storyP2: From the turquoise domes of Samarkand to the ancient walls of Khiva, our well-maintained fleet has carried thousands of travelers across this beautiful country. We take pride in offering transparent pricing, 24/7 roadside support, and vehicles that meet international safety standards.
about.storyP3: Today, with over 50 vehicles and a team of dedicated professionals, we continue to grow — driven by our passion for hospitality and the belief that every journey should be comfortable.

about.value3Desc: No hidden fees, no surprises. What you see is what you pay — clear pricing and honest communication.

faq.metaDescription: Everything you need to know about renting a car with us in Uzbekistan.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about renting a car with us in Uzbekistan.
faq.q1: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a1: We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak tourist season (April–October). However, we can sometimes accommodate same-day bookings depending on availability.
faq.q2: Can I modify or cancel my reservation?
faq.a2: Yes! Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before your pickup time. Modifications can be made anytime through our website or by contacting support.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and cash (USD or UZS). Online payments are processed securely through our booking system.
faq.q4: Do I need an international driving license?
faq.a4: Yes, foreign nationals need a valid international driving permit (IDP) along with their national driver's license. We verify documents at pickup.
faq.q5: Is insurance included in the rental?
faq.a5: Yes, all rentals include comprehensive insurance coverage. Additional premium coverage options are available for extra peace of mind.
faq.a6: Absolutely! Our cars come with unlimited mileage. Popular routes include Tashkent–Samarkand, Samarkand–Bukhara, and the Fergana Valley loop.
faq.q7: What happens if the car breaks down?
faq.a7: We provide 24/7 roadside assistance across Uzbekistan. Call our support line and we'll send help or a replacement vehicle as quickly as possible.
faq.a8: Our policy is full-to-full. You receive the car with a full tank and return it with a full tank. Fuel costs are not included in the rental price.
faq.ctaSubtitle: Our friendly team is always happy to help. Reach out via phone, email, or visit our office in Tashkent.
